description: Fund flows as ETFIQ publishes them, computed from each fund's daily change in shares outstanding times its NAV. With ticker: that fund's net flow over 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD and 1Y, each with its dates and its share of net assets at the window's start, its streak, and its filed N-PORT months. Without ticker: the biggest inflows and outflows among every fund with daily data for window (1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD or 1Y; default 1W), how many funds were counted, each row with the last day its numbers reach (through; a row short of the window counts fewer days), and the latest weekly flows report (Monday to Friday) with its own top inflows and outflows, each with its days. Filter by desk, category (Stocks, Bonds, Commodities, Allocation) or issuer. It answers questions about money going into or out of ETFs.
name: etf_flows
